failure_policy: Stop on the first failure and preserve every contact. No retry, no scoring, no partial quality read. A failed smoke stops cell E4-1 and the arm does not open. The resume-recovery clause of owner decision 22 applies to the arm, not to a four-row dry run, which is re-flown whole if it is re-flown at all.

population.decision_population: Four rows of the unchanged TRAIN Fold A roster chosen to exercise the blind and forced-choice relisten contacts: the first four rows in roster order whose sealed AGREE answer delivered >= 3 entities and whose delivered entity set differed between the sealed AGREE arm and its wave A/A re-fly (a model-free, gold-free rule over sealed outputs; scripts/flights/e4/e4_cost_measure.py).

purpose: Four-row charged dry run of cell E4-1 (the design's section 6 step 2; a form proof, claims_benefit false): that the 17-ceiling relisten program loads, that every row with a delivered entity seals a saea-relisten-v1 receipt whose blind and forced-choice contacts verify under I7l, that at least one forced-choice contact fires, that the realised contact count equals the sealed receipts' contacts_used plus the AGREE-form contacts, that nothing truncates, that the delivered text is untouched and that both shadow columns render with zero intent differences. Never scored for benefit and never read: four rows can never be evidence of benefit or of harm. THE BASE CHANGE (the only one besides the relisten block): policy phase-native-candidates-review-revise-v1 (ceiling 11) -> phase-native-candidates-review-revise-relisten-v1 (ceiling 17 = 11 + 2 x max_slots_per_row 3; the two program fragments differ only in program_id and max_contacts; the Solver stays uncited). THE RELISTEN BLOCK: native_episode.relisten {"blind_template_id": "slurp_relisten_blind_v1", "confirm_template_id": "slurp_relisten_confirm_v1", "delivery": "shadow", "max_slots_per_row": 3, "policy": "saea-obs-targeted-relisten-v1", "value_max_words": 8} -- a post-accept stage after the deliver normaliser: for up to 3 delivered entities per row, in delivery order, a BLIND contact (packet + decided intent + slot type, never the delivered value) and, when the blind value is canonically different, unheard or unparsed, a FORCED-CHOICE contact (delivered value vs the blind value or the unheard sentinel, order fixed by sha256(sample_id, slot type); the decided intent only, never Perception's candidates). SHADOW DELIVERY: the delivered answer is the AGREE form's own and is never mutated; the saea-relisten-v1 receipt is sealed per row and two shadow columns (relisten-replace-only, relisten-replace-drop-unheard) are rendered offline. The delivered path's request bytes are the AGREE arm's EXCEPT the two program-identity fields the switch moves (the program id inside quoted prior contact ids; remaining_model_contacts, +6) -- proven by scripts/flights/e4/e4_shadow_proof.py. Nothing else moves: roster (arm), geometry, session, role graph, max_revisions 1, the agreement term and its sealed table, every knowledge store and pin, every template, the deliver normaliser and the scorers are the AGREE arm's, byte for byte.

stage3_algorithm.note: This cell carries NO training-free RL operator and says so explicitly: E4-1 is a post-accept OBSERVATION node (owner decisions 180 and 185) -- one pre-declared, model-free trigger and acceptance rule over two core-native re-listen contacts per targeted entity, read as two offline shadow columns against the same flight's delivered column -- with no rollout pool, no per-sample credit, no update operator, no evolving store and no selection among sampled answers (so not inference-time-verification-v1, whose selection operator commits one of several sampled answers). The design's section 6 names a dedicated STAGE3_ALGORITHMS label; none is registered on this branch, so the cell is labelled 'none' with this note.
